title: Continue-link click treats the 413 JSON envelope as success — false 'Link sent', beacon suppressed, draft_saved event fired
detail: Payloads over the 64 KB draft-write cap (no maxlength on ~40 text inputs) get the 413 {"error":...} envelope, which parses and has no ok key — so body.ok === false is false: the UI shows 'Link sent — check your inbox', marks the payload acknowledged (pagehide beacon then skips), and fires application_draft_saved, though nothing was saved or emailed. res.ok is never checked on this path.
recommended_fix: Gate success on res.ok too, e.g. .then(function (res) { return res && res.ok && res.json ? res.json() : { ok: false }; }) so any non-2xx envelope renders CONTINUE_FAILED.

title: saveNow's keepalive fetch throws synchronously for >64 KiB bodies, escaping the promise chain on every step change
detail: Per the Fetch spec, a keepalive request whose body exceeds 64 KiB throws a TypeError synchronously, before any promise exists — the .catch never runs and the exception propagates uncaught out of the debounce timer callback. Reachable with large pasted values (text inputs are uncapped); state stays clean (id nulled first) but every subsequent step change re-throws and the save can never succeed.
recommended_fix: Wrap the env.fetch(...) call in try/catch (silent failure, same as network errors), or omit keepalive when payload.length approaches the 64 KiB keepalive limit.
